mapper.sql: multiIf( isNull(accurateCastOrNull(${valueColumn}, 'Float64')), ${valueColumn}, toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn}) = 0, '0', abs(toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn})) < 0.0001, concat( toString(round(toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn}) / pow(10, floor(log10(abs(toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn}))))), 3)), 'e', toString(floor(log10(abs(toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn}))))) ), toString(round(toFloat64OrZero(${valueColumn}), 4)) ) AS "value"

WITH profiles AS ( SELECT study_id, profile_id, replaceOne(profile_id, concat(study_id, '_'), '') AS profile_type FROM VALUES( 'study_id String, profile_id String', (#{profile.cancerStudyIdentifier}, #{profile.stableId}) ) ), genes AS ( SELECT entrez_gene_id, hugo_gene_symbol, type FROM gene WHERE entrez_gene_id IN #{item} ), samples AS ( SELECT sample_unique_id, sample_stable_id, patient_stable_id FROM sample_derived WHERE cancer_study_identifier IN (SELECT study_id FROM profiles)
AND sample_unique_id IN (#{sampleUniqueIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler})
) SELECT p.profile_id AS "molecularProfileId", s.sample_stable_id AS "sampleId", s.patient_stable_id AS "patientId", p.study_id AS "studyId", g.entrez_gene_id AS "entrezGeneId",
g.entrez_gene_id AS "gene_entrezGeneId", g.hugo_gene_symbol AS "gene_hugoGeneSymbol", g.type AS "gene_type",
FROM genetic_alteration_derived d INNER JOIN profiles p ON p.study_id = d.cancer_study_identifier AND p.profile_type = d.profile_type INNER JOIN genes g ON g.hugo_gene_symbol = d.hugo_gene_symbol INNER JOIN samples s ON s.sample_unique_id = d.sample_unique_id WHERE d.cancer_study_identifier IN (SELECT study_id FROM profiles) AND d.profile_type IN (SELECT profile_type FROM profiles) AND d.hugo_gene_symbol IN (SELECT hugo_gene_symbol FROM genes) AND d.sample_unique_id IN (SELECT sample_unique_id FROM samples)
